> **Contradicted by D-21.** This note's premise — that spec migration must proceed under the current file-per-requirement convention because TBD-1 is unresolved — was true when written and is false now. TBD-1 resolved on 2026-08-29. D-21 reaches the opposite conclusion: proceed under the resolved TBD-1 shape, not the current convention. This is a substantive contradiction, not a renumbering.

## Decision

The doc/specs cleanup and extension proceeds under the current file-per-requirement convention and existing frontmatter schema. The D8 frontmatter and granularity migration stays deferred until TBD-1 resolves.

## Rationale

Hierarchy repair, a hierarchy lint rule, bin/ledger to gw reference updates, and new concept nodes are all shape-neutral: they survive whichever granularity TBD-1 picks. Blocking them on a prototype decision strands the corpus in its current state, where two competing root conventions exist and spec lint is blind to both.

## Alternatives Considered

- Resolve TBD-1 first via the ticket-01 prototype, then do all spec work in the new shape
- Do only the hierarchy repair now and defer the extension
